stories.label: Still waiting · World · Press
stories.head: Imran Aliyev
bullets: Founder of parliament-watch site Meclis.info, held since 18 Apr 2024.
Sentenced to 10 years on 12 Nov on smuggling and financial charges.
His lawyer says no credible evidence was shown; he will appeal.

photo.alt: A lit stone colonnade beside an open courtyard of ruins and arches at night, with old buildings behind.
photo.caption: Baku's Old City at night, in 2016. File photo of the city where he was sentenced.

stories.label: Still waiting · World · Assembly
stories.head: Osman Kavala
bullets: Civil society figure held since 18 Oct 2017; serving life.
Appeals court again refused release and retrial (reported 14 Nov).
Europe's rights court ordered release; Ankara denies the case is political.

photo.alt: A large curved glass and stone office building beside a wide road under a blue sky.
photo.caption: Istanbul's Çağlayan courthouse in 2017. File photo of the city's main courthouse.

stories.label: Still waiting · India · Due process
stories.head: Sharjeel Imam
bullets: Held since 28 Jan 2020 under UAPA and other charges.
Supreme Court bail plea says no witness examined yet; not yet heard.
India's US envoy says USCIRF has 'no locus standi' on his case.

photo.alt: A domed red and cream building with an Indian flag, behind trees and a black statue on a pedestal.
photo.caption: The Supreme Court of India in New Delhi, where Sharjeel Imam's bail plea is pending, in 2019.

stories.label: Still waiting · World · Due process
stories.head: Dr Hussam Abu Safiya
bullets: Gaza hospital director held since 27 Dec 2024 without charge.
Israeli courts refused to free 14 detained doctors (reported 11 Nov).
Israel alleges Hamas links; his family denies them.
